rows.quote: For replication analyses, we used COPD GWAS summary statistics from the Million Veteran Program (MVP), which included 103,054 European ancestry cases and 315,450 ancestry-matched controls [26].
rows.coder_note: Sentence names COPD GWAS summary statistics from the Million Veteran Program with a citation; no dictionary outcome row for it.

rows.quote: Plasma proteome GWAS (pQTL) data were sourced from Sun et al. [37].
